decisions.reason: As a newly launched add-on with its own page, repeated releases, and a clear link to the firm's established web-mapping offer, it has enough visible commitment and sunk development effort to make withdrawal unlikely so soon.

This bundle is close to the core offer, but because it was only mentioned briefly rather than highlighted as strategic, management would be somewhat more willing to drop it than more visible products, though escalation of commitment still favors keeping it for now.
Its appearance on the home page and its fit with mobile geospatial usability signal public commitment and relevance to customer needs, which under an escalation logic supports continued backing.

Because this platform is a flagship product line and part of the firm's stated strategic direction, management is very unlikely to remove it after having invested heavily and committed to it publicly.
Mobile field data capture is close to the firm's established GIS solutions and was given its own page, so the firm has enough investment and external commitment to persist with it.
As a search extension tied to the existing web-map business and presented on its own page, it is likely to be retained while management gives the recent launch more time to justify prior effort.
